sql.sql: SELECT review_state,count(*) count,sum(json_extract(current_json,'$.amountFen')) amountFen FROM candidate GROUP BY review_state
SELECT status,error_code,attempt,candidate_count FROM import_job ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT count(*) count,sum(amount_fen) totalFen FROM "transaction" WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT occurred_date,sum(amount_fen) totalFen FROM "transaction" WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY occurred_date

SELECT c.id candidateId,c.job_id jobId,c.image_asset_id assetId,c.prepared_hash preparedHash FROM candidate c JOIN import_job j ON j.id=c.job_id JOIN image_asset a ON a.id=c.image_asset_id WHERE c.prepared_hash=j.prepared_hash AND j.prepared_hash=a.prepared_hash
